wattz.ponder.alternator.text_1: The Alternator produces electricity based on how much RPM it is given.
wattz.ponder.alternator.text_2: Higher tiers produce more electricity but generally at a higher voltage.
wattz.ponder.alternator.text_3: You can further upgrade an alternator by inserting stator upgrades. (1 max)
wattz.ponder.alternator.text_4: Remember to use transformers to either step down or step up the voltages if you plan on using them with lower or higher voltage machinery.
wattz.ponder.alternator.text_5: §cElectricity is not the same as FE.
